title: Critical-zone and misleading tickets still cost 3-7x a plain session
desc:
The clean bench run (bench/results/2026-09-27-9abd3c9) met WB-53's 2x target on BN-7 and on BN-3's wall time and cost, not elsewhere. BN-4 (bug in shop/users.py, user-data zone) cost 6.7x tokens: wb finish only learns the change is in a critical zone after it is made, sends it to the standard route, and the session discarded its working fix to re-plan it. BN-6 cost 2.8x, spent tracing the live code path that plain skipped.

ACCEPTANCE:
- a ticket whose change lands in a critical zone keeps the change it already made when it moves to the standard route, and the plan starts from that diff instead of from scratch
- wb start says up front when the ticket's likely files are in a critical zone, so the session plans first instead of finishing twice
- the bench's BN-4 ratio is measured again and the README table updated
